name: Vietnam — 16 May 2026

BASIC.name: Basic salary

references.title: Labour Code 2019 arts.94(1), 97(1); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.54(1)(a1), (a3): a monthly wage pays the month; a part month pays the working days of the employment over the month’s working days (calendar days only where the entity plans no shifts); a half-monthly part pays half the month, and a part of a half (a joiner or leaver) pays its working days at the monthly day wage — the monthly wage over the month’s normal working days (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) — capped at the half.

BASIC.quantity:
(period.working_days > 0
  ? (period.parts > 1
  &&period.covered_working_days < period.working_days
  &&period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0
    ?min(
      1.0,
      double(period.covered_working_days) * double(period.parts)
      /double(
        period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days
      )
    )
    :double(period.covered_working_days) / double(period.working_days))
  :double(period.paid_days) / double(period.days))

OVERTIME.name: Overtime

references.title: Labour Code art.98(1)(a): at least 150% on a normal day. Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.54(1)(a3)–(a4): the day wage is the monthly wage divided by the normal working days of the month the enterprise chose, the hour wage the day wage divided by the normal hours of the day (Labour Code art.105); art.55(1)(a): the overtime hour wage is the month’s wage for the work divided by the actual normal hours of the month.. Engine: the day rate is the monthly wage over the month’s normal working days, period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days (the calendar month’s planned WORK days, a public holiday falling on one counted: Decree 145/2020 art.54(1)(a)(a3) divides by “số ngày làm việc bình thường trong tháng”, and a public holiday is a paid day off, Labour Code art.112(1), not a weekly rest day, art.111; the same in both halves of a semi-monthly month), hours a day the mean scheduled hours of those days; an entity without planned shifts falls back to rules.working_time (26 days of 8 hours, the most a 48-hour week allows under art.105). Wage base: Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.55(1)(a) (and art.56 for night work) prices the premium on the actual wage for the work, which leaves out only overtime, night and holiday pay, bonuses and the meal, fuel, phone, travel, housing, childcare and other supports unrelated to the job; the job-related wage allowances (phụ cấp lương, Labour Code art.90(1)) stay in. The hour wage is therefore terms.base_salary plus the contract’s FIXED_ALLOWANCE lines; meal, housing, work-expense and insurance-equivalent classes stay out. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf p.41

OVERTIME.eligibility:
sum(
  work.days.filter(
    d,
    (!work.holidays.exists(
      h,
      h.date == d.date
      &&h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"]
      && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE"
      || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates
    ) )))
    &&!(d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]
  ) )).map(
    d,
    d.overtime_hours
  )
)
>0.0
OVERTIME.quantity:
sum(
  work.days.filter(

    (!work.holidays.exists(
      h,

OVERTIME.rate:
1.5
* ((terms.base_salary
+sum(
  terms.allowances.filter(a, a.code == "FIXED_ALLOWANCE").map(
    a,
    double(a.amount)
  )
))
/ ((period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0
  ?double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days)
  :double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))
* (size(
  work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0)
)
>0
  ?sum(
    work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0).map(
      d,
      d.scheduled_hours
    )
  )
  /double(
    size(
      work.days.filter(
        d,
        d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0
      )
    )
  )
  :double(rules.working_time.normal_hours_per_day))))

NIGHT_WORK.name: Night work premium

NIGHT_OVERTIME.name: Night overtime supplement

references.title: Labour Code art.98(3); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.57(1)(b): night overtime adds 20% of the day-time hour wage of that day — 100% of the normal hour wage on a normal day without day-time overtime, 150% with it, 200% on a weekly rest day, 300% on a holiday. Engine: a day's night overtime hours are the night hours of its overtime span (work.days[].overtime_intervals, from where the planned hours run out; every hour on a rest day, every paid hour on a holiday); day-time overtime is present when the day's overtime exceeds those night hours. Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.54(1)(a3)–(a4): the day wage is the monthly wage divided by the normal working days of the month the enterprise chose, the hour wage the day wage divided by the normal hours of the day (Labour Code art.105); art.55(1)(a): the overtime hour wage is the month’s wage for the work divided by the actual normal hours of the month.. Wage base: Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.55(1)(a) (and art.56 for night work) prices the premium on the actual wage for the work, which leaves out only overtime, night and holiday pay, bonuses and the meal, fuel, phone, travel, housing, childcare and other supports unrelated to the job; the job-related wage allowances (phụ cấp lương, Labour Code art.90(1)) stay in. The hour wage is therefore terms.base_salary plus the contract’s FIXED_ALLOWANCE lines; meal, housing, work-expense and insurance-equivalent classes stay out. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf p.41

)

entries.instructions: Official Gazette (Công báo) of Vietnam. Read the Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 and Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP for the pay and leave catalogues: annual, seniority, personal and unpaid leave and their entitlements; the work items pay is built from — wages and wage forms (time, piece, product), overtime, night work and work on rest days and public holidays and their pay rates, leave pay, stoppage pay; payments on termination — severance and job-loss allowance, payment in lieu of untaken leave; bonuses and allowances; employer advances and their recovery; temporary suspension of the contract and suspension from work; and the employer-paid occupational-accident and disease payments under Law 84/2015/QH13. Where: “Văn bản đăng công báo” (/van-ban-dang-cong-bao.htm) filtered by issuer — Quốc hội, Chính phủ (c1), Bộ Nội vụ (c5) — or the search box by số ký hiệu; each record links the signed PDF on congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn. Check the record’s amendment and replacement links.

Vietnam Social Security (Bảo hiểm xã hội Việt Nam). Read the fund-paid benefits that replace pay as leave classes — sickness, maternity, paternity and convalescence (Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 and its decrees and circulars): who qualifies, durations and who pays during the absence. Where: the “Văn bản” menu (/vanban/pages/default.aspx, filtered by DanhMucBanHanh: laws, decrees, circulars, VSS decisions) and “Văn bản chỉ đạo - điều hành” for VSS guidance; each document page carries the attached PDF.

Government document system (vanban.chinhphu.vn), a second official route to the same Government instruments. Use it to reach the Labour Code implementing decrees and Ministry circulars on leave, wages and termination payments when the Gazette record is missing or unreadable. Where: the Government’s document system — search by số ký hiệu, issuer and subject, or browse the newest issuances; open the document and all its attachments and annexes.

Vietnam Social Security (Bảo hiểm xã hội Việt Nam). Read the compulsory insurance contribution schemes: social insurance (Law 41/2024/QH15), health insurance (Law 25/2008/QH12 as amended by Law 51/2024/QH15), unemployment insurance (Law on Employment 74/2025/QH15) and occupational accident and disease insurance (Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP) — coverage (foreigners, short and part-time contracts, the 14-day unpaid rule), the insurance salary and which allowances count, rates and employer/employee shares, the floor and the 20× caps (the reference level / base salary decree in force; the regional minimum wage for unemployment insurance) and rounding. Also read Decree 374/2025/NĐ-CP art.5 on unemployment-insurance contributions. Where: the “Văn bản” menu (/vanban/pages/default.aspx, filtered by DanhMucBanHanh: laws, decrees, circulars, VSS decisions) and “Văn bản chỉ đạo - điều hành” for VSS guidance; each document page carries the attached PDF. Use the operative instrument, not a news item, for any rate or cap.

Official Gazette (Công báo) of Vietnam. Read personal income tax withholding: the PIT Law 109/2025/QH15 (art.29(2) tax table), the family-deduction Resolution 110/2025/UBTVQH15 and Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC — residence, taxable and exempt income, family deductions, the progressive table and the flat rates for non-residents and casual payments; and the employer’s 2% trade-union fee (Law on Trade Unions 50/2024/QH15 art.29 and Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP (replacing Decree 191/2013/NĐ-CP from 16 May 2026)) — base, rate, reductions and suspensions. Vietnam has no statutory training or foreign-worker levy on payroll. Where: “Văn bản đăng công báo” (/van-ban-dang-cong-bao.htm) filtered by issuer — Quốc hội, Chính phủ (c1), Bộ Tài chính (c10) — or the search box by số ký hiệu; each record links the signed PDF on congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn. Check the record’s amendment and replacement links.

Government document system (vanban.chinhphu.vn), a second official route to the same Government instruments. Use it to reach the decrees and Ministry of Finance circulars on personal income tax and the trade-union fee when the Gazette record is missing or unreadable. Where: the Government’s document system — search by số ký hiệu, issuer and subject, or browse the newest issuances; open the document and all its attachments and annexes.

Official Gazette (Công báo) of Vietnam. Read the limits the law sets: the regional minimum wage decree (Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP, including art.5(5) on retained floors) and its regions; the Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 and Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP on normal working hours, overtime caps and the 300-hour sectors, night work, weekly rest, wage periods and payment methods, deductions from wages, probation, minors and young workers; the payslip and wage records (art.95(3)) and record retention, employee personal-data protection (Law 91/2025/QH15 and its decree). Where: “Văn bản đăng công báo” (/van-ban-dang-cong-bao.htm) filtered by issuer — Quốc hội, Chính phủ (c1), Bộ Nội vụ (c5), Bộ Công an (c26) — or the search box by số ký hiệu; each record links the signed PDF on congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn. Check the record’s amendment and replacement links.

Government document system (vanban.chinhphu.vn), a second official route to the same Government instruments. Use it to reach the regional minimum wage decree and the Labour Code implementing decrees on working time and wages. Where: the Government’s document system — search by số ký hiệu, issuer and subject, or browse the newest issuances; open the document and all its attachments and annexes.

Official Gazette (Công báo) of Vietnam. Read the Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 and Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP for what events must cause: a weekly rest day falling on a public holiday or Tết day (the compensatory day off), an exit (final settlement deadline and which pending entitlements are paid out or closed), a contract suspension or resumption, and each payroll run (the wage period it settles and payment by the due date). Where: “Văn bản đăng công báo” (/van-ban-dang-cong-bao.htm) filtered by issuer — Quốc hội, Chính phủ (c1) — or the search box by số ký hiệu; each record links the signed PDF on congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn. Check the record’s amendment and replacement links.

Vietnam Social Security (Bảo hiểm xã hội Việt Nam). Read what an employment event requires of the insurance record: closing or suspending participation on exit or unpaid absence, and the handling of arrears and refunds after a retroactive change. Where: the “Văn bản” menu (/vanban/pages/default.aspx, filtered by DanhMucBanHanh: laws, decrees, circulars, VSS decisions) and “Văn bản chỉ đạo - điều hành” for VSS guidance; each document page carries the attached PDF.

Vietnam Social Security (Bảo hiểm xã hội Việt Nam). Read the employer’s VSS duties: registration of the unit and of each employee, monthly or quarterly remittance deadlines, increase/decrease reports on hire and cessation, and the procedures and forms (e.g. D02-LT under Quyết định 366/QĐ-BHXH). Where: the “Văn bản” menu (/vanban/pages/default.aspx, filtered by DanhMucBanHanh: laws, decrees, circulars, VSS decisions) and “Văn bản chỉ đạo - điều hành” for VSS guidance; each document page carries the attached PDF.

Official Gazette (Công báo) of Vietnam. Read the employer duties with deadlines: tax registration, PIT declaration, payment and annual finalisation (Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14, Decree 126/2020/NĐ-CP); trade-union fee payment deadlines (Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP (replacing Decree 191/2013/NĐ-CP from 16 May 2026)); reporting labour use and changes to the labour authority, overtime-limit notices, collective dismissal and other notifications under the Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 and Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP; foreign workers’ work permits and their reports (Decree 219/2025/NĐ-CP); occupational-accident reporting (Law 84/2015/QH13); the payslip each wage payment and wage registers. Where: “Văn bản đăng công báo” (/van-ban-dang-cong-bao.htm) filtered by issuer — Chính phủ (c1), Bộ Tài chính (c10), Bộ Nội vụ (c5) — or the search box by số ký hiệu; each record links the signed PDF on congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn. Check the record’s amendment and replacement links.

Official Gazette (Công báo) of Vietnam. Read what the payroll must hold: currency (VND) and the tax year and PIT period (the PIT Law 109/2025/QH15 (art.29(2) tax table), the family-deduction Resolution 110/2025/UBTVQH15 and Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC); wage periods, payment timing and the monthly-wage basis for daily and hourly rates (Labour Code 45/2019/QH14, Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP); whether net pay may be negative after deductions; which period settles an exit; and the statutory facts and numbers held per employee and entity — tax code, dependants, residence, contract type and term, region of workplace, work-permit status. Where: “Văn bản đăng công báo” (/van-ban-dang-cong-bao.htm) filtered by issuer — Quốc hội, Chính phủ (c1), Bộ Tài chính (c10) — or the search box by số ký hiệu; each record links the signed PDF on congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn. Check the record’s amendment and replacement links.

Vietnam Social Security (Bảo hiểm xã hội Việt Nam). Read the identifiers and facts the insurance record needs per employee and unit: the social-insurance number, the unit code and the region and contract facts that decide coverage. Where: the “Văn bản” menu (/vanban/pages/default.aspx, filtered by DanhMucBanHanh: laws, decrees, circulars, VSS decisions) and “Văn bản chỉ đạo - điều hành” for VSS guidance; each document page carries the attached PDF.

change_summary: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP (issued 31 March 2026, in force 16 May 2026) replaces Decree 191/2013 for the trade union fee: still 2% of the social-insurance salary fund, now paid by the last day of the month after the month, with a suspension or a reduction of at most 20% by Confederation decision (arts.12–13).

employment_type.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.20: PERMANENT is an indefinite-term contract, CONTRACT a fixed term of at most 36 months; PROBATION (art.24–27), PART_TIME (art.32), INTERN (art.61) and DOMESTIC (art.161, outside unemployment insurance). SERVICE: paid without a labour contract (a service or casual engagement): PIT 10% on payments at the threshold (Circular 111/2013 art.25(1)(i); Decree 253/2026 art.50(2)).

work_classification.description: Labour Code art.113(1): 12 days of annual leave for ordinary work, 14 for heavy, hazardous or dangerous (ARDUOUS) and 16 for especially heavy, hazardous or dangerous work.

residency_status.description: CITIZEN: a Vietnamese citizen resident for PIT (also in unemployment insurance). PERMANENT_RESIDENT: a foreigner with a permanent residence card (PIT resident). RESIDENT: another foreigner resident for PIT (183 days in the year or a home for 183 days). NON_RESIDENT: taxed at 20% with no deductions. PIT refuses any other value: the law presumes neither.

prior_floor_region.title: Worksite region on 31 December 2025
prior_floor_region.description: Decree 293/2025 art.5(5): the worksite's minimum-wage region under the prior order, read for an incumbent whose area was reclassified lower.

prior_floor_reclassified.title: Area reclassified lower in 2026
prior_floor_reclassified.description: True only when the same worksite was assigned a lower 2026 region by the decree.

probation_class.title: Probation job class (Labour Code art.25)
probation_class.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: probation at most 180 days for an enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises, Law on State Capital), 60 days for a job needing college-level or higher qualifications, 30 days for intermediate-level, technical-worker or clerical jobs, 6 working days for any other job. Record it on probation terms.

probation_job_wage.title: Wage of the job on probation
probation_job_wage.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.26: the probation wage is at least 85% of the wage of that job. Record the job’s agreed wage on probation terms.

normal_hours_arrangement.title: Normal working-time arrangement
normal_hours_arrangement.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(1)–(2): daily arrangement allows at most eight normal hours a day; weekly arrangement allows at most ten, both at most 48 a week. Unrecorded arrangement defaults to DAILY.

normal_hours_notified_on.title: Working-time arrangement notified on
normal_hours_notified_on.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(2): record when the worker was notified of the selected daily or weekly arrangement. A date records the notification; retain delivery evidence separately.

pass_type.title: Work-permit basis
pass_type.description: INTRA_COMPANY_TRANSFER is outside compulsory SI (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

net_of_tax.title: Net-of-tax salary
net_of_tax.description: The employer bears the PIT: the tax is grossed up on the converted income (Circular 111/2013 art.7, Annex 02).

hourly_rate.title: Hourly rate (hourly-paid terms)
hourly_rate.description: Checked against the regional hourly minimum wage (Decree 293/2025 art.3(2)).

minor_listed_job.title: A job listed for minors’ overtime and night work

work_permit_valid_until.title: Work permit valid until
work_permit_valid_until.description: A foreign employee's work permit expiry (Decree 219/2025/NĐ-CP art.21: at most two years). Raises the extension task 45 days before it (art.28(1)) and the permit return on exit (art.31(1)).

annual_leave_combined.title: Annual leave combined across years (agreed)
annual_leave_combined.description: Labour Code 2019 art.113(4): the employee and employer agreed to combine annual leave over up to three years. The unused days of the two previous calendar years carry in (carry_depth 2); days older than that lapse.

child_arts_sports_approved.title: Under-13 arts or sports work approved
child_arts_sports_approved.description: Labour Code 2019 art.145(3): a child under 13 works only in arts, physical training or sports work with the provincial labour authority’s consent; true records that consent.

contract_type.title: Labour contract type
contract_type.description: Labour Code 2019 art.20(1): an indefinite-term contract (INDEFINITE) or a fixed-term one of at most 36 months (FIXED, record agreed_term_months). The 10% PIT on contracts under three months and the SI coverage of contracts under one month (twelve for foreigners) read the agreed term, not the exit date; with neither fact recorded the months from start to exit stand in.

agreed_term_months.title: Agreed contract term (months)
agreed_term_months.description: The term the fixed-term labour contract states, in months (Labour Code art.20(1)(b)): Circular 111/2013 art.25(1)(i) / Decree 253/2026 art.50(2) (10% PIT under three months), Law 41/2024 art.2(1)(a) (SI from one month) and art.2(2) (a foreign employee from twelve months).

special_role_notice.title: Special-role notice period
special_role_notice.description: Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.7 (Labour Code arts.35(1)(d), 36(2)(d)): an aircrew member, aircraft or aviation equipment maintenance staff, flight dispatcher, enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises; Law on State capital), ship crew working abroad or a seafarer on a Vietnamese ship abroad. Notice is at least 120 days for an indefinite or 12-month-plus contract and a quarter of the term for a shorter one.

receiving_pension.description: A worker already receiving a retirement pension: outside compulsory social, health-by-employer and unemployment insurance (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2), so the SI-equivalent allowance is paid instead.

disabled.description: A person with a disability: fourteen days of annual leave (Labour Code 2019 art.113(1)) and the disabled new-hire unemployment-insurance relief.

fixed_term.description: A fixed-term contract: while true the employment is not permanent (`permanent_when`).

pension_eligible.title: Qualifies for a pension on leaving
pension_eligible.description: Labour Code 2019 art.46(1): no severance allowance where the employee qualifies for a pension under the social insurance law (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.64).

absent_five_days.title: Dismissed for five days' unexcused absence
absent_five_days.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(e): the employer ended the contract after five consecutive working days absent without good reason; art.46(1) owes no severance allowance.

final_settlement_extended.title: Settlement period extended to 30 days
final_settlement_extended.description: Labour Code 2019 art.48(1): settlement within 14 working days of termination; only art.48(1)(a), (c), (d) — the employer ceased operating; a merger, division, sale or transfer; natural disaster, fire, enemy action or epidemic — allow up to 30 days. Unrecorded is the 14-day rule.

unlawful_resignation.title: Left unlawfully
unlawful_resignation.description: Labour Code art.40: a worker who ended the contract unlawfully gets no severance and owes half a month’s wage and the unserved notice.

long_illness.title: Ended for a long illness
long_illness.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(b): the employer ended the contract because the employee stayed unable to work after the treatment period (12 months indefinite, 6 months fixed term, half the term under 12 months); art.36(2)(c) needs only 3 working days’ notice, whatever the contract term.

exit_facts.description: Stored on employment_contract.exit_facts when the contract closes.

kind.description: The standing in the scheme, e.g. MEMBER or EXEMPT.

reference_number.description: The scheme registration number (SI book number, tax code).

union_member.title: Trade union member
union_member.description: UNION_DUES standing: a member pays 0.5% of the insurance salary, at most 10% of the reference level (Law 50/2024 art.29(1)(a); Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ).

dependants.title: Registered dependants
dependants.description: PIT standing: each dependant registered with the tax authority is a monthly family deduction of 6,200,000 (Resolution 110/2025).

finalisation_authorised.title: Authorises the employer PIT finalisation
finalisation_authorised.description: PIT standing: the employer finalises the year only for an employee who authorised it (Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d); Decree 253/2026 art.51 from 2026).

unpaid_leave_continuation.title: SI continued through unpaid leave by agreement
unpaid_leave_continuation.description: SI standing: the parties agreed to keep paying compulsory SI for a month with 14 or more unpaid working days (Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.33(5), 34(3)). Unrecorded is the exemption.

si_treaty_exempt.title: Exempt from Vietnamese SI by treaty
si_treaty_exempt.description: SI standing: a foreign employee an international agreement Vietnam is party to exempts (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

pension_qualified.title: Already qualifies for a pension
pension_qualified.description: UI standing: an employee who qualifies for a pension is outside unemployment insurance (Law 74/2025/QH15 art.31(2)).

disabled_new_hire_relief.title: Disabled new hire registered for the UI relief
disabled_new_hire_relief.description: UI standing: a disabled worker hired from 1 January 2026, registered with the SI agency with the disability certificate; the employer pays 0% UI for 12 months (Decree 374/2025/NĐ-CP art.5).

commitment_form.title: Commitment form 08/CK-TNCN filed
commitment_form.description: PIT standing: a resident with no contract or one under three months who expects no taxable income after the family deduction files form 02/CK-TNCN; the 10% withholding is suspended (Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC art.25(1)(i)).

voluntary_pension_contribution.title: Voluntary pension / life-insurance contribution (VND a month)
voluntary_pension_contribution.description: PIT standing: the employee’s own monthly contribution to voluntary pension, deducted with the employer’s up to 1,000,000 a month (Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC art.9(2)(c)).

facts.description: Person facts: the other keys of employment_profile.facts (CEL employee.facts.*).

si_contribution_years.title: Years of social-insurance contribution
si_contribution_years.description: SICK_LEAVE: 30 working days a year under 15 years of compulsory SI contribution, 40 from 15 to under 30, 60 from 30 — 10 more for arduous or especially arduous work (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.43(1)). Unrecorded meters the 60-day band, so no lawful day is refused.

si_number.title: Social insurance number (mã số BHXH)
si_number.description: The participant’s VSS social insurance number, D02-LT column 1. Leave it unrecorded for a first registration: VSS issues it. Quyết định 366/QĐ-BHXH ngày 29/4/2026, mẫu D02-LT and its guide (https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5018)

hi_registered_facility.title: Initial health-care facility (nơi đăng ký KCB ban đầu)
hi_registered_facility.description: The facility the participant chose for initial health-insurance treatment, D02-LT column 16 on a registration. Quyết định 366/QĐ-BHXH ngày 29/4/2026, mẫu D02-LT and its guide (https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5018)

overtime_300h_sector.title: Eligible for 300 annual overtime hours
overtime_300h_sector.description: Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 overtime hours a year; art.107(3) allows 300 only in the listed sectors and cases (Decree 145/2020 art.61), and art.107(4) only after notifying the provincial labour authority. Unrecorded is the general 200-hour limit.

rest_averaged_monthly.title: Rest averaged monthly
rest_averaged_monthly.description: Labour Code 2019 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; only where the work cycle cannot allow weekly rest may the employer average it to at least four days a month. Unrecorded is the weekly rule.

occupational_accident_reduced.title: Approved reduced occupational accident rate
occupational_accident_reduced.description: Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4(1): the occupational accident and disease fund rate is 0.5% of the salary; the reduced 0.3% applies only to an employer the Ministry approved on application (art.4(1)(b), art.5). Unrecorded is the 0.5% rate.

union_fee_suspended.title: Union fee suspended by decision
union_fee_suspended.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.13: the Vietnam General Confederation of Labour or the provincial federation may suspend the 2% union fee, by month and for at most 12 months, for an enterprise or cooperative in difficulty from restructuring, technological change, economic crisis, State restructuring policy, natural disaster, fire, epidemic or crop failure that meets art.13(2). Record it only for the decision’s months; unrecorded is the fee in full. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

union_fee_reduction_percent.title: Union fee reduction by decision (%)
union_fee_reduction_percent.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.12: after an art.13 suspension ends, an enterprise or cooperative that must still cut its workforce by the art.12(1) threshold may be granted a reduction of at most 20% of the 2% fee (art.12(3)), by month and for at most 6 months (art.12(2)(a)), by decision of the Confederation or the provincial federation. Record the decided percentage only for those months; unrecorded is 0. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

pit_quarterly_filer.title: Declares salary PIT quarterly (quarterly VAT filer)
pit_quarterly_filer.description: Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14 art.44(1)(a)–(b) with Decree 126/2020/NĐ-CP arts.8(1), 9: a payer eligible to declare VAT quarterly may declare salary PIT quarterly; unrecorded is the monthly return by the 20th. From 1 July 2026 (Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC art.22(1)(a)(a.1)) every salary payer declares quarterly and this input is not read.

stoppage_pay_percent.title: Agreed stoppage pay (% of the contract wage)
stoppage_pay_percent.description: Labour Code 2019 art.99(2)–(3): for a stoppage caused by a co-worker or an objective cause the parties agree the stoppage wage, not below the regional minimum wage (for a longer stoppage, the first 14 working days). STOPPAGE_REDUCTION deducts the difference between the contract day wage and the larger of this share and the regional minimum day wage (company.region). Unrecorded is full pay.

six_monthly_health_checks.title: Six-monthly health checks
six_monthly_health_checks.description: Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.21(1): health checks at least once a year, every six months for heavy, hazardous or dangerous work, minors, the disabled and the elderly. Set when the entity employs any of them; unrecorded raises the yearly check only.

vss_unit_code.title: Vietnam Social Security unit code
vss_unit_code.description: The employer’s SI/HI/UI unit code (mã đơn vị) with Vietnam Social Security (Law 41/2024 art.28).

tax_code.title: Enterprise tax code
tax_code.description: The employer’s tax identification number for PIT withholding returns.

pdpl_exempt.title: Exempt from PDPL dossier and personnel duties
pdpl_exempt.description: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 art.38(2)–(3): a household business or micro-enterprise is exempt, and a small enterprise or startup may opt out for 5 years from 1 January 2026, from the impact assessment (arts.21–22) and the data-protection personnel (art.33(2)) duties — unless it processes sensitive data or the data of a large number of subjects, or provides data-processing services. Unrecorded is not exempt.

state_owned_enterprise.title: State-owned enterprise
state_owned_enterprise.description: UNION_DUES: in a State enterprise members pay 0.5% of the take-home salary after SI, HI, UI and PIT, at most 10% of the base salary (Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ); elsewhere 0.5% of the SI salary.

union_fee_quarterly.title: Union fee paid every three months
union_fee_quarterly.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.4(1)(b), (2)(b): an agricultural, forestry, fishery or salt employer paying wages by production cycle may register with the union to pay every three months, by the last day of the month after the cycle. Unrecorded is monthly.

work_expense_limit.title: Monthly work-expense allowance limit (internal rules)
work_expense_limit.description: PIT: phone, stationery, travel and work-clothing allowances are taxable only above this level (Decree 253/2026 art.8(2)(đ)). Unrecorded is 0: the whole allowance is taxable.

vss_result_delivery.title: VSS result delivery (hình thức nhận kết quả)
vss_result_delivery.description: How the unit receives VSS results (bản điện tử or bản giấy), D02-LT column 17; the guide requires it on an exit, retirement or transfer. Unrecorded leaves the column empty. Quyết định 366/QĐ-BHXH ngày 29/4/2026, mẫu D02-LT and its guide (https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/vanban/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5018)
